items.t: Battle to control GPS and radio signals raises civilian safety concerns
items.d: From aid convoys in conflict zones to passenger jets and cargo ships far out at sea, safe journeys depend on GPS, satellite navigation and old-fashioned radio transmissions. But these signals are increasingly being blocked or faked – and civilians are paying the price.

items.t: Peacekeeping: With 500 paternity and child support claims unresolved, UN scales up accountability

items.t: ‘Losing the battle’: AI hands predators new ways to target children

items.t: COP31: Ambition goes missing as fossil fuel language drops from draft deal

items.t: No government approval needed to form or join a group, UN rights committee says

items.t: World’s top court finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya
items.d: The International Court of Justice, the principal judicial organ of the UN, delivered its judgment on Thursday in the case of The Gambia v. Myanmar on the application of the Genocide Convention, finding Myanmar responsible for the crime against the country’s ethnic Rohingya, the first such ruling against a State.
